summary: Lipocine Inc. filed an 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) on May 7, 2026, solely to disclose that it had updated its corporate investor presentation, filed as Exhibit 99.1. No merger, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, restructuring, or other special situation event is described. The filing is a routine update of marketing materials, constituting an ordinary current report. No deal terms, prices, premiums, advisors, or board recommendations are mentioned. The disclosure is purely informational and does not trigger any special-situations classification.
